description: Pins the shared config_id positive-int rejection, the proto-enum purpose rejection, and the config-interface add POST body. Both languages now serve it from the proto contract, so the rejection cases carry confirm: the generated live path gates on confirm before it reads any argument. A retired ipv6 argument is dropped rather than sent: the route's body schema has no such member.

cases.name: rejects non-positive config_id
cases.expect_error: config_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects an invalid purpose
cases.expect_error: purpose must be one of: public, vlan, vpc

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This adds a network interface to the configuration profile. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: An interface will be added to configuration profile 7 on Linode 123.

cases.name: refuses a retired ipv6 argument instead of dropping it
